THEARCHITECT-SCRY.title: Scry
THEARCHITECT-SCRY.description: Look at that many cards from the top of your draw pile. Discard any number of them, keeping the remaining cards in their original order.
THEARCHITECT-CORRUPTED_ENERGY.title: Energy
THEARCHITECT-CORRUPTED_ENERGY.descriptio: The Corrupted Player's current energy. This is not a forecast of future damage.
THEARCHITECT-CORRUPTED_PLAN.title: Corrupted Player Plan
THEARCHITECT-CORRUPTED_PLAN.description:
Plays its hand left to right, reconsidering after each card. Choices select the first valid option.

Its Attack intent appears while its current hand holds any Attack, regardless of cost. Installed modded cards use their own effects. Ally-only cards need a living corrupted teammate.
THEARCHITECT-CORRUPTED_STARS.title: Stars
THEARCHITECT-CORRUPTED_DRAW_PILE.title: Draw Pile
THEARCHITECT-CORRUPTED_DRAW_PILE.descrip:
Cards the Corrupted Player will draw.

Click to view its draw pile.
THEARCHITECT-CORRUPTED_DISCARD_PILE.desc:
Shuffled into the Corrupted Player's draw pile when that pile is empty.

Click to view its discard pile.
THEARCHITECT-CORRUPTED_EXHAUST_PILE.desc:
Cards the Corrupted Player has exhausted this combat.

Click to view its exhaust pile.
